groups.instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

items.prompt: How long was the library closed for the refurbishment?

options.text: twelve months
eighteen months
two years

items.evidence: We closed in March last year expecting to be shut for a year; in the end it took eighteen months

distractor_analysis.A: Söylendi sonra düzeltildi — konuşmacı bir yıl kapalı kalmayı beklediklerini söylüyor; iş sonunda on sekiz ay sürdü.
distractor_analysis.C: Sesle hiç geçmeyen çeldirici — iki yıllık bir süre hiç anılmıyor.

items.explanation: The librarian says they expected to be closed for a year, but because of the heating pipes the work took eighteen months.

items.prompt: How many items can library members now borrow at one time?

options.text: three
twelve
fifteen

items.evidence: You can borrow fifteen items at a time; before the refurbishment it was twelve.

distractor_analysis.A: Söylendi ama sorulan bu değil — üç sayısı ödünç süresinin (üç hafta) rakamı, ödünç sınırı değil.
distractor_analysis.B: Söylendi sonra düzeltildi — yenilemeden önceki sınır on ikiydi; artık bir seferde on beş.

items.explanation: The borrowing limit was twelve before the refurbishment; members can now borrow fifteen items at a time.

items.prompt: When does the reading group now meet?

options.text: on the first Tuesday of the month
on the second Tuesday of the month
on Saturday mornings at half past ten

items.evidence: The reading group meets on the second Tuesday of the month at seven; it used to be the first Tuesday, but the choir has that evening now.

distractor_analysis.A: Söylendi sonra düzeltildi — okuma grubu eskiden ayın ilk Salı'sında toplanıyordu; o akşam artık koronun.
distractor_analysis.C: Söylendi ama sorulan bu değil — Cumartesi sabahı on buçuk, beş yaş altı için masal saatinin zamanı.

items.explanation: The reading group now meets on the second Tuesday of the month at seven; the choir has taken the first Tuesday evening.

items.prompt: Which TWO things does the speaker say about the mural?

options.text: It shows the building as it looked in 1906.
It is displayed in the children's library.
It was painted by local schoolchildren.
It was designed by the community librarian.
A leaflet explains what it contains.

items.evidence: That was painted by children from the two primary schools on either side of the park, and each class chose one object from the local history collection to put into it. There's a leaflet by the door that explains what they chose and why.

distractor_analysis.A: Söylendi ama sorulan bu değil — bin dokuz yüz altı binanın açılış yılı; resmin içeriği olarak anılmıyor.
distractor_analysis.B: Söylendi ama sorulan bu değil — çocuk kütüphanesi konuşmanın başka yerinde geçiyor; resim merdiven boşluğunda.
distractor_analysis.D: Sesle hiç geçmeyen çeldirici — resmi kütüphanecinin tasarladığı hiç söylenmiyor.

items.explanation: The mural was painted by pupils from the primary schools on either side of the park (C), and a leaflet by the door explains what is in it (E). Second answer point: L2-S2-29.

groups.instructions: Choose the correct letter, A, B or C.

items.prompt: Why did the students not survey the site below the weir?

options.text: The footbridge leading to it was shut.
The brook was in flood.
Their tutor said five sites would be enough.

items.evidence: The footbridge you have to cross to reach it has been fenced off since the winter storms

distractor_analysis.B: Söylendi ama sorulan bu değil — taşkın Haziran'da ikinci ziyareti geciktiren etken; alanın bırakılma sebebi değil.
distractor_analysis.C: Başkası söyledi — 'beş alan yeter' danışmanın sonradan verdiği onay; alan zaten kapalı köprü yüzünden bırakılmıştı.

items.explanation: The footbridge leading to the site below the weir has been closed since the winter storms, and there is no other way in without entering the water.

items.prompt: When did the students carry out their second round of sampling?

options.text: in the last week of May
four weeks after the first visit
in the middle of July

items.evidence: The second was supposed to be four weeks after that, but it slipped to the middle of July, because the brook was in flood for most of June.

distractor_analysis.A: Söylendi ama sorulan bu değil — Mayıs'ın son haftası birinci turun zamanı.
distractor_analysis.B: Söylendi sonra düzeltildi — plan ilk turdan dört hafta sonrasıydı; dere taşkın olunca tarih Temmuz ortasına kaydı.

items.explanation: The second round was planned for four weeks after the first, but because the brook was in flood throughout June it slipped to the middle of July.

items.prompt: What does Marisol say is wrong with Rhys's suggested structure?

options.text: It would conceal the overall pattern.
It would ignore the order of collection.
It would take longer to write.

items.evidence: And I think that hides the pattern completely.

distractor_analysis.B: Başkası söyledi — toplama sırasına göre gitmek Rhys'in kendi düzenini savunma gerekçesi; Marisol'un eleştirisi değil.
distractor_analysis.C: Söylendi ama sorulan bu değil — yazma kolaylığından söz eden danışman ve tersini söylüyor: Rhys'in düzeni daha kolay yazılır.

items.explanation: Marisol says that organising it site by site completely hides the overall pattern: the reader has to keep track of five separate sets of figures in their head.
